units.rawText: The Oasis, Zone G Sandbox Barrier.
units.displayText: The Oasis, Zone G Sandbox Barrier.

spans.text: The Oasis, Zone G Sandbox Barrier.

units.rawText: Explosions erupt in rapid succession, but the tide is not so easily stemmed. Under the Entropic fluid's corrosion, the formerly unassailable defense nodes crumble one after the other.
units.displayText: Explosions erupt in rapid succession, but the tide is not so easily stemmed. Under the Entropic fluid's corrosion, the formerly unassailable defense nodes crumble one after the other.

spans.text: Explosions erupt in rapid succession, but the tide is not so easily stemmed. Under the Entropic fluid's corrosion, the formerly unassailable defense nodes crumble one after the other.

units.rawText: Damn, there's way too many of them!
units.displayText: Damn, there's way too many of them!

spans.text: Damn, there's way too many of them!

units.rawText: Be on alert, everyone! That thing... is here.
units.displayText: Be on alert, everyone! That thing... is here.

spans.text: Be on alert, everyone! That thing... is here.

units.rawText: An alluring chorus emerges from the tail end of the Entropic swarm, drawing a stark contrast to the cacophony. As if enchanted by the melody, the Entropic throng attacks with renewed intensity.
units.displayText: An alluring chorus emerges from the tail end of the Entropic swarm, drawing a stark contrast to the cacophony. As if enchanted by the melody, the Entropic throng attacks with renewed intensity.

spans.text: An alluring chorus emerges from the tail end of the Entropic swarm, drawing a stark contrast to the cacophony. As if enchanted by the melody, the Entropic throng attacks with renewed intensity.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>We ought to take on more graceful forms for the occasion.</color>
units.displayText: We ought to take on more graceful forms for the occasion.

spans.text: We ought to take on more graceful forms for the occasion.

units.rawText: The High Order Entropic leans down, gently caressing its minions. The Entropics touched by its tentacle quickly begin to warp and metamorphose, melting down into Entropic Liquid.
units.displayText: The High Order Entropic leans down, gently caressing its minions. The Entropics touched by its tentacle quickly begin to warp and metamorphose, melting down into Entropic Liquid.

spans.text: The High Order Entropic leans down, gently caressing its minions. The Entropics touched by its tentacle quickly begin to warp and metamorphose, melting down into Entropic Liquid.

units.rawText: Quickly, one after another, newly-born Entropic jellyfish emerge from the substance.
units.displayText: Quickly, one after another, newly-born Entropic jellyfish emerge from the substance.

spans.text: Quickly, one after another, newly-born Entropic jellyfish emerge from the substance.

units.rawText: That thing is... turning the other Low Order Entropics into Entropic jellyfish?! What kind of joke is this?
units.displayText: That thing is... turning the other Low Order Entropics into Entropic jellyfish?! What kind of joke is this?

spans.text: That thing is... turning the other Low Order Entropics into Entropic jellyfish?! What kind of joke is this?

units.rawText: We need to stop her... prepare the barrier's ordnance systems!
units.displayText: We need to stop her... prepare the barrier's ordnance systems!

spans.text: We need to stop her... prepare the barrier's ordnance systems!

units.rawText: The cannon barrel slowly rotates towards the High Order Entropic while the Entropic jellyfish nearby form a protective barrier in front of her using their own bodies.
units.displayText: The cannon barrel slowly rotates towards the High Order Entropic while the Entropic jellyfish nearby form a protective barrier in front of her using their own bodies.

spans.text: The cannon barrel slowly rotates towards the High Order Entropic while the Entropic jellyfish nearby form a protective barrier in front of her using their own bodies.

units.rawText: Charge complete... target locked, firing!
units.displayText: Charge complete... target locked, firing!

spans.text: Charge complete... target locked, firing!

units.rawText: <size=40>BOOM!</size>
units.displayText: BOOM!

spans.text: BOOM!

units.rawText: Wow, would you look at that. Anna-enhanced indeed...
units.displayText: Wow, would you look at that. Anna-enhanced indeed...

spans.text: Wow, would you look at that. Anna-enhanced indeed...

units.rawText: Shush. Stay alert.
units.displayText: Shush. Stay alert.

spans.text: Shush. Stay alert.

units.rawText: As the dust clears, a portion of the Entropic jellyfish fell limp into the Entropy Liquid on the ground, but there was nary a scratch to be found on the High Order Entropic.
units.displayText: As the dust clears, a portion of the Entropic jellyfish fell limp into the Entropy Liquid on the ground, but there was nary a scratch to be found on the High Order Entropic.

spans.text: As the dust clears, a portion of the Entropic jellyfish fell limp into the Entropy Liquid on the ground, but there was nary a scratch to be found on the High Order Entropic.

units.rawText: But how... Even that won't do anything to blunt their offense...
units.displayText: But how... Even that won't do anything to blunt their offense...

spans.text: But how... Even that won't do anything to blunt their offense...

units.rawText: Anna, the barrier is losing operands in multiple locations! It should be in the same manner as before...
units.displayText: Anna, the barrier is losing operands in multiple locations! It should be in the same manner as before...

spans.text: Anna, the barrier is losing operands in multiple locations! It should be in the same manner as before...

units.rawText: Crap... Send Sol and Magnhilda to deal with the Entropic jellyfish on the barrier. I'll help you stabilize here!
units.displayText: Crap... Send Sol and Magnhilda to deal with the Entropic jellyfish on the barrier. I'll help you stabilize here!

spans.text: Crap... Send Sol and Magnhilda to deal with the Entropic jellyfish on the barrier. I'll help you stabilize here!

units.rawText: The Sandbox Barrier defenses and the fire from the armed agents only slow the advance of Entropy. More and more Entropic jellyfish affix themselves to the newly repaired Sandbox Barrier as pressure piles onto Antonina and Horizon.
units.displayText: The Sandbox Barrier defenses and the fire from the armed agents only slow the advance of Entropy. More and more Entropic jellyfish affix themselves to the newly repaired Sandbox Barrier as pressure piles onto Antonina and Horizon.

spans.text: The Sandbox Barrier defenses and the fire from the armed agents only slow the advance of Entropy. More and more Entropic jellyfish affix themselves to the newly repaired Sandbox Barrier as pressure piles onto Antonina and Horizon.

units.rawText: Persicaria, we're struggling to hold back these Entropic jellyfish. If this continues, it's only a matter of time until we lose the Sandbox Barrier!
units.displayText: Persicaria, we're struggling to hold back these Entropic jellyfish. If this continues, it's only a matter of time until we lose the Sandbox Barrier!

spans.text: Persicaria, we're struggling to hold back these Entropic jellyfish. If this continues, it's only a matter of time until we lose the Sandbox Barrier!

units.rawText: ...I see.
units.displayText: ...I see.

spans.text: ...I see.

units.rawText: Persicaria clenches her fists, arriving at a decision.
units.displayText: Persicaria clenches her fists, arriving at a decision.

spans.text: Persicaria clenches her fists, arriving at a decision.

units.rawText: Abandon the Sandbox Barrier and fall back.
units.displayText: Abandon the Sandbox Barrier and fall back.

spans.text: Abandon the Sandbox Barrier and fall back.

units.rawText: What?!
units.displayText: What?!

spans.text: What?!

units.rawText: Persicaria, I can still fight! The Sandbox Barrier is our most important line of defense, we can't just give it up!
units.displayText: Persicaria, I can still fight! The Sandbox Barrier is our most important line of defense, we can't just give it up!

spans.text: Persicaria, I can still fight! The Sandbox Barrier is our most important line of defense, we can't just give it up!

units.rawText: Rather than exhaust all of our resources holding onto the barrier, we should abandon it to open up more tactical options.
units.displayText: Rather than exhaust all of our resources holding onto the barrier, we should abandon it to open up more tactical options.

spans.text: Rather than exhaust all of our resources holding onto the barrier, we should abandon it to open up more tactical options.

units.rawText: Being the person most familiar with the state of the barrier, surely you would agree, Antonina?
units.displayText: Being the person most familiar with the state of the barrier, surely you would agree, Antonina?

spans.text: Being the person most familiar with the state of the barrier, surely you would agree, Antonina?

units.rawText: Despite her surprise in the face of Persicaria's decision, Antonina nods.
units.displayText: Despite her surprise in the face of Persicaria's decision, Antonina nods.

spans.text: Despite her surprise in the face of Persicaria's decision, Antonina nods.

units.rawText: As it is, repeatedly repairing the barrier is equivalent to handing supplies over to the Entropics. In terms of straight-up combat, we have few edges over these Entropic jellyfish.
units.displayText: As it is, repeatedly repairing the barrier is equivalent to handing supplies over to the Entropics. In terms of straight-up combat, we have few edges over these Entropic jellyfish.

spans.text: As it is, repeatedly repairing the barrier is equivalent to handing supplies over to the Entropics. In terms of straight-up combat, we have few edges over these Entropic jellyfish.

units.rawText: But I must ask, what are your plans after retreating from the barrier?
units.displayText: But I must ask, what are your plans after retreating from the barrier?

spans.text: But I must ask, what are your plans after retreating from the barrier?

units.rawText: I established a secondary line of defense behind the barrier for this exact situation.
units.displayText: I established a secondary line of defense behind the barrier for this exact situation.

spans.text: I established a secondary line of defense behind the barrier for this exact situation.

units.rawText: We may have no more time for chatter. Antonina, please further renovate and reinforce the Sandbox Barrier.
units.displayText: We may have no more time for chatter. Antonina, please further renovate and reinforce the Sandbox Barrier.

spans.text: We may have no more time for chatter. Antonina, please further renovate and reinforce the Sandbox Barrier.

units.rawText: I will reallocate some squads from areas largely relieved from pressure to construct another defensive line behind the barrier, just in case.
units.displayText: I will reallocate some squads from areas largely relieved from pressure to construct another defensive line behind the barrier, just in case.

spans.text: I will reallocate some squads from areas largely relieved from pressure to construct another defensive line behind the barrier, just in case.

units.rawText: Understood.
units.displayText: Understood.

spans.text: Understood.

units.rawText: The construction of those defensive lines is now complete. I plan to use the tactical depth available to us to remove the Entropic jellyfish surrounding the High Order Entropic, allowing us to focus our efforts on important targets.
units.displayText: The construction of those defensive lines is now complete. I plan to use the tactical depth available to us to remove the Entropic jellyfish surrounding the High Order Entropic, allowing us to focus our efforts on important targets.

spans.text: The construction of those defensive lines is now complete. I plan to use the tactical depth available to us to remove the Entropic jellyfish surrounding the High Order Entropic, allowing us to focus our efforts on important targets.

units.rawText: Sounds more workable than holding onto the Sandbox Barrier... I understand.
units.displayText: Sounds more workable than holding onto the Sandbox Barrier... I understand.

spans.text: Sounds more workable than holding onto the Sandbox Barrier... I understand.

units.rawText: Wait... are we really going to just hand over the outer layer of the Oasis?! We've gone to all this effort to defend it until now...
units.displayText: Wait... are we really going to just hand over the outer layer of the Oasis?! We've gone to all this effort to defend it until now...

spans.text: Wait... are we really going to just hand over the outer layer of the Oasis?! We've gone to all this effort to defend it until now...

units.rawText: ...If it were possible, I'd not give up a single inch of the Oasis. We built it up with our own hands, after all.
units.displayText: ...If it were possible, I'd not give up a single inch of the Oasis. We built it up with our own hands, after all.

spans.text: ...If it were possible, I'd not give up a single inch of the Oasis. We built it up with our own hands, after all.

units.rawText: Even with Persicaria's attempts to hold steady, Sol still catches a faint tremble in her voice.
units.displayText: Even with Persicaria's attempts to hold steady, Sol still catches a faint tremble in her voice.

spans.text: Even with Persicaria's attempts to hold steady, Sol still catches a faint tremble in her voice.

units.rawText: Sol, since we built the Oasis, we've seen far too much sacrifice.
units.displayText: Sol, since we built the Oasis, we've seen far too much sacrifice.

spans.text: Sol, since we built the Oasis, we've seen far too much sacrifice.

units.rawText: Even if we retreat, so long as you, I, and the Exiles are all still here, we can build back the Oasis as many times as we need.
units.displayText: Even if we retreat, so long as you, I, and the Exiles are all still here, we can build back the Oasis as many times as we need.

spans.text: Even if we retreat, so long as you, I, and the Exiles are all still here, we can build back the Oasis as many times as we need.

units.rawText: But if our friends are Entropized, even if we reset them, we'll never have the original them back.
units.displayText: But if our friends are Entropized, even if we reset them, we'll never have the original them back.

spans.text: But if our friends are Entropized, even if we reset them, we'll never have the original them back.

units.rawText: Sol looks outside of the Oasis' boundaries, the fires of war ubiquitous beyond the Sandbox Barrier. Countless figures flash in the forefront of her mind, and she eventually nods.
units.displayText: Sol looks outside of the Oasis' boundaries, the fires of war ubiquitous beyond the Sandbox Barrier. Countless figures flash in the forefront of her mind, and she eventually nods.

spans.text: Sol looks outside of the Oasis' boundaries, the fires of war ubiquitous beyond the Sandbox Barrier. Countless figures flash in the forefront of her mind, and she eventually nods.

units.rawText: Sol...
units.displayText: Sol...

spans.text: Sol...

units.rawText: You're right. Everyone's safety is more important than everything else.
units.displayText: You're right. Everyone's safety is more important than everything else.

spans.text: You're right. Everyone's safety is more important than everything else.

units.rawText: Alright, stop being all glum. We'll retreat to the secondary defense line and wait for your orders there!
units.displayText: Alright, stop being all glum. We'll retreat to the secondary defense line and wait for your orders there!

spans.text: Alright, stop being all glum. We'll retreat to the secondary defense line and wait for your orders there!

units.rawText: I'll meet you there!
units.displayText: I'll meet you there!

spans.text: I'll meet you there!
